description: This file defines a Dart class 'NotesDatabase' that manages a SQLite database for notes application. It handles database initialization, schema creation, change notification, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: A class that manages opening, initializing, and interacting with a SQLite database for storing notes, including change notifications.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Asynchronously returns an instance of the database, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: notifyChanged
methods.description: Increments change tick and emits a notification on changeStream.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database and the change notification stream.
